BehaviorTree._description: Select a queue of planar map goals, then approve and execute each planned leg in order. Confirm Pose only queues a waypoint; approve each computed path before the rover moves. Cancellation, rejection, or any error prevents later legs. The rover's velocity controller is active from startup, so no controller is switched.

SubTree.input_port: Number of map goals to confirm before navigation, from 1 to 50.
Seconds to wait for each planning or execution result. Negative values wait until completion or cancellation; positive values bound each leg. Zero is refused.
